goal: Document-ready akışını authenticated invoice route üzerinden server caller’a bağlamak
rollback: Bu paketin route ve testini geri al; mevcut belge, ödeme, teslimat ve veritabanı verilerine dokunma
acceptance: Route session and invoice capability checks happen before any decision
Route derives workspace and actor from the server session
Route accepts only bounded match/approval input and delegates to the caller
Raw provider values, PII and delivery internals are not exposed
